summary: This is an 8-K filing by Avantor, Inc. reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreement entered into by its wholly owned subsidiary, Avantor Funding, Inc. The amendment adds €374.2 million in Incremental B-7 Euro Term Loans that refinance existing euro term loans, reducing the interest spread from 2.50% to 2.00% per annum while maintaining the same October 9, 2032 maturity. A 1.00% prepayment premium applies for six months on early refinancing with lower-yield debt. As a routine debt refinancing with no change in equity or control, this does not constitute a special situation.
